South Africa captain Temba Bavuma: "We had it first up with the ball but what I said to 
the team was to keep our shape. With our batting, the approach was the same. Assess 
conditions first and then back our execution. That was a big confidence booster for 
Shamsi. We still back him as our match-winner. In the last couple of weeks, I'm just 
enjoying my cricket. There's a certain backing in the team environment at the moment. 
It always makes things a lot better when you know the 'how'. I don't think I've changed 
anything technically but just think my plans are a lot clearer." 
Player of the Match is Sisanda Magala for his 3 for 37: "It's just keeping it as simple as 
possible. It's important to not try to overthink stuff and that was my role today. I like to 
envision what I want to achieve during the game. If it works, it works. If it doesn't, it 
doesn't. The nerves are always there. The team environment is very good and very 
welcoming. They embrace everyone's differences. You can go out there and express 
yourself. It's an environment where people are encouraged to go out and excel. I'm 
excited and nervous about the opportunity [to go to the IPL] because it'll be the longest 
I've ever been away from home. Tomorrow is packing day." 
Netherlands captain Scott Edwards: "It was a good start but we've got to go on with it 
from there. 189 was always going to be well below the mark. We needed to bowl 
exceptionally, which we didn't. We've had a lot of decent innings but we need guys to 
start going on and get big hundreds. Hopefully we can come back and put on a better 
show on Sunday." 
Shamsi and Magala's three-fors had kep Netherlands to a low score before South Africa 
coasted in the chase. Peter will be here shortly with the presentations.

expected. As soon as the winning runs were hit, Bavuma fist-bumped in the direction of 
the dressing room before sharing a hug with Markram at the other end. Handshakes 
and hugs all around in the home team's dressing room. Bavuma and Markram's 
partnership was worth 102 unconquered and more importantly before the rain. A lot of it 
was forecast for today but South Africa have managed to seal the deal before it even 
arrived.
